title: Furnishing/Interior Decoration for Renovated Inspection Quarter at Patpur FFM station, Odisha.-reg.
summary: Two-cover e-tender for furnishing and interior decoration of the renovated Inspection Quarter at Patpur FFM station, Odisha.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata

sites.name: Patpur FFM station, Odisha
sites.work: Furnishing/interior decoration of renovated Inspection Quarter

scope.item: Furnishing/Interior Decoration for Renovated Inspection Quarter

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR/Bank Guarantee of scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata payable at Kolkata, valid three months from technical bid opening; exemption not allowed; original EMD to reach office by 06/10/2025 15:00. Tender fee Nil.

period.bid_validity: 180 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration of appropriate class in appropriate category (Building civil work/Interior Decoration) in Central govt department/undertaking/autonomous body or State govt
Similar works in last 7 years: three >= 40%, two >= 50% or one >= 80% of estimated cost; similar works = furnishing and interior decoration works; values enhanced at 7% p.a.
Notarized affidavit (2025) of not blacklisted/debarred; unconditional price bid undertaking; tender acceptance letter
notes: NIT only (pages 3-6); no BOQ. Bid download 15/09/2025 18:00 to 06/10/2025 15:00; pre-bid 26/09/2025 15:00; technical opening 07/10/2025 16:00. Digitally signed 15.09.2025. No NIT/file reference printed. Patpur FFM (fixed fog/field monitoring) station is not in station list. Bidders asked to visit site before quoting.
